tile_source: City of Bend 2019 orthoimagery (ArcGIS Online tile cache), fetched by scripts/aerial_fetch_tiles.py and passed with --input
deviation: Tile2Net's Oregon source is commented out upstream ('SSL issues'), and the Oregon Statewide Imagery Program server (imagery.oregonexplorer.info, OSIP_2022_WM) presented a TLS certificate that expired 2026-09-26; fetching it unverified was not done. Bend's GSV panos are mostly 2024 (84%): a ~5-year imagery gap.
network: FAILED: Tile2Net's pedestrian-network step raised centerline.exceptions.TooFewRidgesError in pednet.create_crosswalk (2026-09-28T17:52:53-07:00) after the polygons were written. Bend has polygons only; its Q3 anchors come from polygon contacts alone (Paterson is also scored that way as a sensitivity).
vram_note: Three short runs WITHOUT --deterministic (Boston example, two 1 km2 Paterson pilots, ~50 s each, 2026-09-28 16:04-16:10 PT) peaked at ~34 GB VRAM from cudnn benchmark probing while another job held ~9 GB, leaving ~3 GB free on the shared A40 (below the 20 GB-free rule). Every run that produced results used --deterministic: 1.4 GB peak.
